Sickies Garage Burgers & Brews is a casual dining restaurant chain founded in 2012 in Fargo, North Dakota. With headquarters in Bismarck, the company operates 13 locations across several states, including Florida, Kansas, Nebraska, Nevada, North Dakota, South Dakota, and Texas. The restaurant employs between 1,001 and 5,000 people.

The restaurant features a garage-themed environment filled with classic cars, trucks, and motorcycles, creating a unique atmosphere for diners. Sickies Garage is known for its extensive menu, which includes 50 unique burger creations and 50 rotating craft brews. Signature burgers range from the Sickies Burger to the Glazed Doughnut Burger, with options for half-pound beef, chicken, or veggie patties, as well as gluten-free buns. The menu also offers chicken wings, salads, loaded mashed potato bowls, and hand-spun malts and milkshakes, including vegan options. 

Sickies Garage operates seven days a week, providing dine-in, takeout, online ordering, and delivery services. The restaurants feature full bars, outdoor seating, and accept credit cards and gift cards, making it a popular destination for burger and craft beer enthusiasts.
